title: PSMA Guided Approach for bIoCHEmical Relapse After Prostatectomy-PSICHE
official: Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA) Guided Approach for bIoCHEmical Relapse After Prostatectomy- A Prospective Observational Study-PSICHE
summary: This observational study was designed to evaluate progression free survival after PSMA-PET/CT based salvage approach for patients affected by biochemical relapse after radical prostatectomy.
conditions: Biochemical Relapse Fo Malignant Neoplasm of Prostate
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed informed consent
* Age \>18
* Patient suitable for 68Ga-PSMA PET/CT re-staging according to clinical practice (Previous radical prostatectomy with histological result of Prostate adenocarcinoma +/- postoperative prostate bed radiotherapy (adjuvant or salvage setting), with a biochemical relapse defined as a PSA \> 0.2 and \<1

Exclusion Criteria:

* ADT administration within 6 months from study enrollment
* Persistent elevation of PSA after RP measured within 16 weeks from surgery (\> 0.1 ng/ml)
